story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless white car picks up at a San Antonio airport curb. A map shows the service started in February in a 60 square mile zone. In April one empty car was carried down Salado Creek and another sat stranded in floodwater. A federal recall record covers 3,791 cars and words the problem as a car that may slow and then drive into standing water. Its remedy is stamped under development, interim weather limits reached every car by April 20, and the film ends with the airport ride open beside the unfinished remedy.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on a car arriving at the airport curb and closes at the same kind of curb with the door open, beside the record card whose remedy row reads under development. The return reframes the open ride against the unfinished remedy without inventing an outcome.
